- Added scripts/pickNameByElement.ts for candidate name selection based solely on favorable element(s), without WuGe analysis.
- Updated SKILL.md to document the new script, describing its parameters, output, and use cases (including non-surname scenarios and pure BaZi/favorable-element matching).

- Improved guidelines for output interpretation, scoring logic, and user communication, including separation of favorable-element and WuGe-driven processes.

cantian-naming 1.0.0

- Initial skill release for 三才五格姓名分析与起名推荐 (Three-talents and five-grid Chinese name analysis & name suggestion).
- Provides scripts for: 
  - Analyzing Chinese name components, five-grid scores, and elemental attributes.
  - Generating recommended names (single/double character) based on surname and favored 五行 elements.
- Outputs detailed Markdown reports for both analysis and candidate generation.
- Enforces strict input validation and error handling for script parameters.
- Supports flexible configuration for 喜用神五行, name length, and candidate pool filtering.
